moments.title: Black Friday frenzy hits the UK
moments.blurb: Black Friday officially lands today, November 27, with retailers across the UK offering major discounts online and in-store, marking the start of the festive shopping season.

moments.title: Cyber Monday approaches
moments.blurb: The online shopping event, Cyber Monday, is set for Monday, November 30, following the Black Friday weekend, with many retailers extending their digital discounts.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Peter Buck
